module_domains.full_product: equal nonempty inputs, 2n output limbs, caller scratch >=12n, fixed or caller-selected threshold >=24
module_domains.full_square: nonempty input, 2n output limbs, caller scratch >=10n, threshold >=24
module_domains.weighted_evaluation: three equal blocks plus a no-longer-than-first fourth block; each weight <=8 and total weights <=15; k+1 output limbs
module_domains.interpolation: seven independently input-defined nonnegative coefficients and 128 times their sum below output radix; exact odd divisors 3,9,15
module_domains.low_product_and_square: same precision and split conventions as existing verified low kernels

resource_evidence: Actual recursive bodies include the disjoint caller-scratch layout and slice length obligations; acceptance requires the matching full verification report

asymptotic_scope.domain: limb count n, fixed cutoff independent of n
asymptotic_scope.relation_to_sat_variable_count: No claim about whole SAT solver complexity is made by this arithmetic experiment

performance_claim: No performance acceptance follows from this scope; separate fixed-source measurements are required

entry_candidate_scope.independent_meaning: Input integer product or square modulo the requested power of two, unchanged from the arithmetic contract
entry_candidate_scope.product_change: Direct call to the original small-product kernel; preserve the single existing size decision
entry_candidate_scope.square_change: Separate complete small and large square contracts; inline the small body and selecting wrapper, keep the large body out of line
entry_candidate_scope.alias_and_capacity: Safe mutable slice exclusivity, full input/precision domains, 12n product scratch and 10n square scratch unchanged
entry_candidate_scope.cost_boundary: The mathematical recurrence is unchanged. Codegen inspection must establish dispatch/frame effects; runtime improvement is unclaimed before new complete measurements.

odd_division_scope.independent_meaning: A=d*Q with unchanged limb length; low-to-high scalar identity d*q+c=x+B*next, 0<=next<d, B=2^64
odd_division_scope.direct_domain: d in {3,9,15}; every u64 input word, every incoming carry 0<=c<d; exact arrays including empty; no truncation or narrowing of word range
odd_division_scope.existing_api_domain: divide_exact preserves every positive u64 divisor and exact-input precondition; other divisors retain the original high-to-low division body
odd_division_scope.final_carry: An independently stated modular inverse of B modulo d cancels B^n; exactness and carry<d establish final carry=0
odd_division_scope.runtime_storage: In place, constant machine-word temporary state, same caller workspace and Toom policy; proof/spec sequence values erase
odd_division_scope.cost_scope: Analytic O(n) word operations and O(1) runtime auxiliary storage for the odd loop; no verified machine-cost theorem; unchanged Toom recurrence

parent_control_performance: Odd-division candidate was target_not_met in both complete runs; frozen experimental control only

fusion_scope.domain: Every u64 word including zero/MAX; empty dst/RHS; rhs length <= dst length; mathematical product <= input destination; safe exclusive mutable dst
fusion_scope.carry_obligation: Combined carry<=word; high==word implies low product==0 and subtraction borrow==0; no narrowing of full-u64 domain
fusion_scope.composition: Exactly pmh-=64*z0, p2-=4*c2, p2-=16*c4, p2-=64*z6; all old interpolation outputs retained including scratch=c3 and p2=3c3
fusion_scope.workspace: No allocation and no new scratch; original 12n/10n capacities retained, scratch not removed
fusion_scope.cost_boundary: Four groups of three source passes become four single passes; analytic O(n) helper and unchanged Toom recurrence, not a checked machine-cost theorem or speed result
